collection.title: Nissan Juke 2017 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Nissan Juke 2017 - 2019 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 14" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Pinch Tab arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Juke, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
